out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, No Unnecessary Persons
violations.observation: Unauthorized personnel, such as children or customers, were observed present in the food preparation, food storage, or warewashing areas. A customer was observed washing their hands in the hand sink located behind the cashier table, in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Persons unnecessary to the food establishment operation are not allowed in the food preparation, food storage, or ware washing areas of the commercial establishment. Only approved tours or brief visits may be authorized by the Person in Charge or certified food manager if steps are taken to ensure that exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, clean linens, and single service items are protected from contamination. UNAUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ARE NOT ALLOWED IN THE BACK OF HOUSE OR KITCHEN AT ANY TIME. PIC TOLD EHS THAT CUSTOMERS REGULARLY USE THE HAND SINK LOCATED BEHIND THE CASHIER TABLE TO WASH THEIR HANDS. THIS IS NEVER ALLOWED. IF CUSTOMERS NEED TO WASH THEIR HANDS, PIC CAN DIRECT THEM TO A PUBLIC BATHROOM LOCATED NEAR BY IN THE MALL. FACILITY CAN ALSO PROVIDE HA D SANITIZER FOR CUSTOMERS TO USE. CUSTOMERS WILL STOP USING THE HAND SINK MOVING FORWARD.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No CFM was present at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE MAKE SURE TO HAVE A CFM PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Both hand sinks at facility did not have hot water at the time of inspection. Both hand sinks were temping at 77F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HOT WATER IS REQUIRED AT ALL HAND SINKS. THE HOT WATER AT THE HAND SINKS MUST REACH A MINIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 100F. PLEASE CALL TECHNICIAN TO LOOK AT THE HOT WATER TANK AMD MAKE SURE IT IS WORKING PROPERLY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Diced tomato (51F); black beans (50F) and garlic based yogurt sauce (50F) in the 1DR Delfield cold holding unit were all not temping properly at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES. DUE TO FOOD ITEMS BEING MADE 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE INSPECTION, PIC THREW AWAY FOODS THAT WERE NOT TEMPING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: One time use garlic storage containers where being reused in the kitchen to store food items such as pico salsa, garlic sauce; shredded cheese and black beans.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE STOP REUSING THE GARLIC CONTAINERS TO STORE OTHER FOOD ITEMS. BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, PLEASE REPLACE ALL GARLIC CONTAINERS WITH FOOD SAFE REUSABLE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The Delfield 1DR UPR cooler in the front of house was not working properly at time of inspection. The cooler was temping at 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC REMOVED ALL FOOD IN THE UNIT TO OTHER COLD HOLDING UNIT IN FACILITY. PLEASE CALL A TECHNICIAN TO LOOK AT COLD HOLDING UNIT. EHS WILL SCHEDULE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION WITH CFM ONCE THE COLD HOLDING UNIT IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. At time of inspection the 3vat sink was temping at 78F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HOT WATER IS REQUIRED AT THE 3 VAT SINK. THE HOT WATER AT THE 3 VAT SINK MUST REACH A MINIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 110F. PLEASE CALL TECHNICIAN TO LOOK AT THE HOT WATER TANK AMD MAKE SURE IT IS WORKING PROPERLY. Shawarma Taco (Inspection Date: 06/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit within 10 days of this inspection.

violations.observation: Both hand washing sinks are equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Both hand sinks were temping at 68F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Raid used to kill ants and cockroaches was found in facility kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT HOME USE PESTICIDES CANNOT BE USED IN A KITCHEN AND CANNOT BE APPLIED BY A NON CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. PIC THREW AWAY RAID.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: A knife being used to prep food was being stored in between a prep table and a prep top unit, where it can not be properly washed, rinsed and sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. MOVING FORWARD, PLEASE STOP STORING KNIVES ANYWHERE THAT IS NOT ABLE TO BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC MOVED KNIFE TO 3 VAT SINK TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer garlic containers were observed being reused for the storage of multiple food items throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHICH CONTAINERS CAN BE REUSED AND THOSE WHICH CANNOT. EHS ADVISED PIC TO REPLACE ALL GARLIC CONTAINERS BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): the gasket for the right door of the Turbo Air 2DR prep top is ripped and falling off the door.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE DOOR GASKET NEEDS TO BE REPLACED. PIC WILL REPLACE DOOR GASKET BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.
